purpose: Declare durable non-market research inputs that Graham Mercer must consult during governed NFL information reviews without granting those sources automatic numeric authority over carried ratings or BW FAIR.

governance.rule: Research sources may identify, confirm, challenge or supersede factual team-state assumptions. They may not set, shade or anchor Graham numbers from sportsbook prices or source opinions.
governance.numericMoveRule: A carried Graham rating or fair-number change requires an explicit governed delta/adjustment, reason, sourceRefs and preserved prior value under the source-locked Walters methodology. No source in this registry may silently move BW FAIR.
governance.freshnessRule: For factual current status, later official or reliable current reporting outranks an older guide snapshot. Preserve the guide item as provenance when later evidence updates it.
governance.opinionRule: VSiN expert picks and Makinen systems are advisory research context only. They are not independent numeric Walters adjustments and may not create a Graham BET or move a Graham fair by themselves.
governance.priceRule: Any prices printed in a guide are historical source snapshots and may not supply executable price authority.

sources.title: 2026 VSiN NFL Betting Guide
sources.notes: Preserves where the 2026 Graham/Makinen rating lineage began. CurrentRating carries forward independently and is never reset merely because this seed exists.

sources.title: 2026 VSiN NFL Betting Guide 2.0
requiredUse: Consult relevant team-state deltas during Graham baseline, daily, late-delta and Sunday pregame research.
Use personnel, injury, role, coaching and roster changes as revalidation prompts and attributable evidence where still current.
Treat the unchanged 32-team Makinen table as confirmation of the origin-seed values only; do not rebase current carried Graham ratings.
Preserve NEW, UPDATED, CONFIRMED, CLARIFIED, SUPERSEDED, CONFLICT and STALE_REVALIDATE classifications when citing this review.
Cross-check material guide facts against current official/reliable information before using them as current-status evidence.
excludedFromNumericAuthority: source consensus or disagreement by itself
sources.notes: This is an update layer on VSiN 1.0, not a second Graham model. It provides reviewed current-information leads and provenance; the governing Walters package and explicit audited adjustment process remain the only path to a Graham numeric change.
